## Load 

```{r}
library("TCGAbiolinks")
```

# Load data

```{r}
test_query <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-BRCA",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
  barcode = c(
    "TCGA-A1-A0SB",
    "TCGA-A1-A0SD",
    "TCGA-A1-A0SE"
  )
)

test_query
```

```{r}
results <- getResults(test_query)

results[, c("id", "file_name")]
```

```{r}
GDCdownload(
  test_query,
  directory = "../data/_raw"
)

```
